To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the stormwater quality modelling based on constant source concentrations is uncertain even if the water quality and rainfall data of a catchment outlet is available, because the dilution effect and the pollutant pathways are not considered.

stormwater pollutant modelling based on constant EMCs is challenging and uncertain, but it provides a useful tool to assess the pollutant sources and the total diffuse pollutant loads at the catchment level.
the use of constant EMCs in stormwater quality modelling can be misleading and that the source area contributions of stormwater pollutants are difficult to quantify at the catchment level.
In summary, our research is concerned with
stormwater quality modelling and management at a local scale.
the use of stormwater quality data for modelling pollutant loads in a catchment.
the use of constant EMCs in stormwater quality modelling, and the results emphasize the need for more local and detailed data on pollutant sources and water quality in stormwater quality management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of constant EMCs in stormwater modelling is not recommended, and the use of local data is preferred.
the use of constant EMCs in SWMM is uncertain.
the use of local water quality data is essential in the modelling of stormwater pollutants, and that the use of literature data is not recommended.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were able to model the stormwater quality in a residential catchment in southern Finland, but the results are not reliable enough to be applied in water quality management.
the use of constant EMCs for modelling pollutant loads in a residential area is not recommended.
the use of constant pollutant source concentrations in SWMM modelling is not suitable for stormwater management in residential areas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
stormwater modelling requires local data on pollutant sources, and the modelling of pollutant loads should be based on the measured pollutant concentrations.
the use of local water quality data in modelling pollutant load dynamics is essential for improving the accuracy of the model results.

the stormwater quality modelling should be improved by using more local data for EMCs, by considering spatial and temporal variability of EMCs, and by including the mechanisms affecting pollutant concentrations along the pollutant pathway.
